# canvas-lms-student-mcp

> Canvas LMS MCP is a free, open source, read only MCP server that lets AI apps (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot and others) read a student's Canvas LMS by Instructure courses, due dates, grades and announcements. It cannot submit, edit or delete anything.

## Setup
- Needs CANVAS_BASE_URL and CANVAS_API_TOKEN.
- Create a token in Canvas under Account, Settings, New Access Token.
- Run with npx -y canvas-lms-student-mcp. Run `npx canvas-lms-student-mcp doctor` to check the setup.

## Tools (all read only)
- get_my_courses
- get_todo
- get_upcoming_due_dates
- get_missing_assignments
- get_assignments
- get_my_grades
- get_course_content
- get_syllabus
- get_announcements
- get_whats_new
- get_discussions
- get_calendar_events
